subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` use recovery-first after an accepted Gateway disconnect, retaining the isolated embedded fallback only when recovery cannot establish a terminal outcome?
rationale: This is a user-facing compatibility choice between promptly rerunning locally and waiting for the authoritative detached run; source review cannot choose that tradeoff.

options.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
options.body: Approve wait-and-cache-replay as the default, retain the current isolated fallback after recovery is exhausted, and require final-head proof of both paths.

options.title: Keep immediate fallback primary
options.body: Retain current-main behavior and narrow or close this PR if prompt local completion is preferred over recovery-first semantics.

options.title: Fail closed on ambiguity
options.body: Require an explicit rerun opt-in after unresolved recovery, with a clearly documented CLI contract and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt recovery-first with isolated fallback
recommendation.body: Approve wait-and-cache-replay as the default, retain the current isolated fallback after recovery is exhausted, and require final-head proof of both paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current fresh-session fallback contract and are the clearest history-backed routing candidate for its successor policy.
